Question: Let \(f\) be the unique function defined on the positive integers such that \[ \sum_{d\mid n} d\cdot f\left(\frac{n}{d}\right)=1 \] for all positive integers \(n,\) where the sum is taken over all positive divisors of \(n.\) What is \(f(2023)?\)
